title: Save stays stuck after the own-exercise limit pop-up
what: On 'New exercise', when the free plan's own-exercise limit is reached, Save shows the limit pop-up and returns without clearing its busy state, so the Save button stays disabled on that screen.
expected: After the limit pop-up the Save button is usable again, as it is after the 'Already in your library' pop-up.
who: members on the free plan when the limit switch is on
how_often: every time the limit is hit (the limit is switched off at launch)
fix_line: Clear savingRef and saving before the limit return
